title: Singularity forces a one-axis rank-one field
statement: For every r>0,a nonzero actual periodic gradient has averaged acoustic-Hessian rank3or4. Singularity forces a one-variable rank-one profile on one acoustic axis with a common output direction. The attained affine-mean minimum is J_r(R)[m4-(2/3)m3²/m2]>=J_r(R)m4/3,sharp over profiles. Kernel mean components cannot uncover unbounded negative energy. Covariance rank>=2 makes the mean Hessian positive definite;the pseudoinverse formula now holds for all actual fields. No uniform control while approaching the singular set is inferred.
